C8545.manufacturer: Jiangsu Changjing Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.

basic_only_policy.decision: ACCEPT Extended for the 0.1 % / 25 ppm thin-film dividers only (documented exception); every other passive stays Basic. Not an order approval.
basic_only_policy.why: They set protection thresholds: the U20 overvoltage guard bands (R93-R96, R98/R99), the U23 OVLO divider (R101/R102) and, since S8.4, the U3 +5V setpoint (R11/R12) that the OVLO release proof depends on. With 1 % + 1 % TCR Basic parts the screens fail (calcs.json basic_only_counterfactual). The searched JLC catalog has no Basic 0.1 % 0603 resistor (keyword snapshots in research/s84/catalog; every hit Extended).
basic_only_policy.cost: Extended per-unique-part fees apply to the precision codes (not included in the q1 parts totals); all selected codes were observed Economic-eligible.
basic_only_policy.not_done: No Basic substitute was qualified; replacing them with 1 % parts would need a new threshold design.
